fields.description: Issue dated December 22, 1934 (Vol. 9, No. 14) containing editorials and local political commentary on Dade County taxation and state revenue policy; coverage of a criminal libel conviction involving Miami Life staff (Wen R. Phillips and Reubin J. Clein) in Judge Brown's court and discussion of Dan Mahoney and the Daily News; Miami Beach election and patronage politics; extensive holiday greetings and local business advertisements; and notices related to NRA/Blue Eagle compliance (including a plumbers' code endorsement) alongside racing-related columns and ads for Tropical Park and other venues.
